meta.title: Improve Rust compiler output
meta.body_summary: Tweak the mochi Rust compiler to print simple string literals without format placeholders and regenerate machine Rust sources.

perf_labels.notes: Codex tweaked Rust compiler to print simple string literals without format placeholders; single commit with 21 regenerated test files; no review, self-merged in 15 seconds.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 51 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, fast-turnaround performance PR and is consistent with the successful, low-friction self-merge.

review_details.performance_claim: Simplify Rust output by emitting plain string literals instead of format-placeholder-based strings, reducing generated code complexity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler codegen optimization in a domain-specific language (mochi) requires understanding of output code patterns; Codex succeeded in a small-scoped change with no human review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after evidence; only a Go test command for integration tests.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression reported; merge was immediate.

core_change_summary.description: In compiler/x/rust/compiler.go, adjusted Rust code emission to output string literals directly without format placeholders. Twenty test golden files under tests/machine/x/rust/ were regenerated to reflect the new output format.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All other file changes are automated regeneration of expected Rust output strings; no behavioral change.
change_trajectory: Single commit tweaked compiler and regenerated 21 test expectation files.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by tamnd with codex label, self-merged 15 seconds later with no human review or interaction.
